📺 Jovan WON. You didn't see it — you had your own arena. The village will tell you about it for weeks.

🕯️ Kanat Galymov is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Kanat kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Kanat's gone." Sofia looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Kanat." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Pavel blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
📖 LEARNED: Radios & Signals (Level 1). Continuity, batteries, and solder. Most dead electronics are just broken connections.
📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
"OH! OH! DEEP READ! The audience did NOT see that coming! Knowledge AMPLIFIES power! The gamblers are recalculating EVERYTHING!"
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Kanat Galymov, 67 days. The mantle passes to Pavel Dubinin.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Pavel Dubinin, 43 — a bush pilot. His hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Lucky Rock.
The village's quarrel was with Kanat — and Kanat is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
You knew Kanat — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting him, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
At the grave, Sofia, Jovan, Sigrun speak for Pavel — "Kanat trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Pavel before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
